fullPassage: We are always teaching our children something by our words and our actions. They learn from seeing. They learn from hearing and from overhearing. Children share the values of their parents about the most important things in life. Our priorities and principles and our examples of good behavior can teach our children to take the high road when other roads look tempting. Remember that children do not learn the values that make up strong character simply by being told about them. They learn by seeing the people around them act on and uphold those values in their daily lives. Therefore show your child good examples of life by your action. In our daily lives, we can show our children that we respect others. We can show them our compassion and concern when others are suffering, and our own self-discipline, courage and honesty as we make difficult decisions.

det.korean: 아이들은 주변 사람들이 그 가치를 (실천하고 지키는) 모습을 보며 배운다
det.analysis:
✅ ① act on and uphold those values(그 가치를 실천하고 지키다): 원문 그대로. 말이 아니라 '행동으로 실천하는' 모습을 보고 배움 ←정답

❌ ② memorize the rules carefully(규칙을 외우다): 암기가 아니라 실천을 강조

❌ ③ repeat the words loudly(말을 크게 반복하다): 말이 아닌 행동이 핵심

❌ ④ read many books daily(매일 책을 많이 읽다): 문맥 무관

ch: act on and uphold those values
